label: If a finite-duration beginning is possible, possibly one has an external cause
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise B2 in sense BEGINS_2, attribution deferred: if some history accessible from the selected world began a finite time ago (in sense BEGINS_2, with a contingent concrete individual existing there), then some accessible history began a finite time ago, has a contingent concrete individual, and has an existing concrete individual, numerically distinct from every contingent concrete individual there, standing in the supplied totality-cause relation there. The totality-cause relation is a parameter, not Ontic.Causes between individuals; the cause is not required to be earlier than anything or present at any moment. Under rigid identity and classical accessibility such an external candidate is a necessary concrete individual of that history (ExternalCandidateNecessity), so the premise, given B1 in the same sense, contains the possibility of a necessary concrete individual. Duration is read with CLOCK_1. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter.
